reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis addresses a completely different alloy system (FeCoNiTi) and property (coercivity) than the research question (MnNiSi-FeCoGe caloric integrity), making it scientifically irrelevant.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is well-defined for the FeCoNiTi system but does not test the hypothesis in the context of the (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy's integrity or caloric performance.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic, focusing on magnetic coercivity in a different alloy, and offers no insight into improving load-bearing integrity while preserving caloric response in the target material.
